{"local_delta": -0.09,
  "departures": [
    {"fact": "State women's-privacy statute (signed 22 Sep 2025, effective 4 Dec 2025) requires restrooms to match birth-certificate sex across schools, universities, prisons and state buildings, with $25,000/$125,000 facility fines, and produced documented state-trooper ID checks at women's restrooms outside the capitol within days.",
     "local_evidence": "\"state police troopers checked identification at women's restrooms outside the state capitol\"; \"Facilities face a $25,000 fine for a first violation and $125,000 for subsequent violations\"; \"the law reaches public schools, universities, prisons and state government buildings\"",
     "direction": "riskier", "magnitude": 0.05,
     "visitor_applicability": "Traveller-facing universal exposure: any visitor presenting at a covered facility carries the check, and violation is framed by documents. Mitigating detail in the same item: trans women holding female ID markers were admitted, so a visitor whose travel document matches presentation may pass; severity is nonetheless carried by everyone.",
     "already_in_national_bundle": false, "counted_in_delta": true},
    {"fact": "Statutory definition act (May/June 2025, effective Sep 2025) fixes binary biological definitions, bars third-gender recognition and bans sex changes on state driver's licences and birth certificates.",
     "local_evidence": "\"requires people with disorders of sex development to select one binary gender with no third-gender recognition\"; \"explicitly bans any change of sex on state/province driver's licences and birth certificates\"",
     "direction": "riskier", "magnitude": 0.02,
     "visitor_applicability": "Resident-facing legal gender recognition machinery; the dossier documents no official rejection or doubting of foreign-issued trans documents. Climate signal only, and per the rules a missing domestic recognition regime is not a visitor exposure.",
     "already_in_national_bundle": false, "counted_in_delta": false},
    {"fact": "Documented state-level trans-specific homicide record with a denominator: 44 recorded killings of trans women 2008-2025, about 7.6 per 100k trans women per year, described as the national worst in absolute terms.",
     "local_evidence": "\"44 recorded killings of trans women over 2008-2025 (about 7.6 per 100k trans women per year)\"",
     "direction": "riskier", "magnitude": 0.03,
     "visitor_applicability": "Reaches trans visitors as public-violence exposure, but the rate sits only modestly above the ordinary population baseline for the region and no organised/state-directed pattern, sweeps or impunity finding is documented; weighted proportionally, not as a campaign.",
     "already_in_national_bundle": false, "counted_in_delta": true},
    {"fact": "Civil-society/visibility rollback: a city council rescinded its LGBTQ non-discrimination ordinance (Dec 2025), a local Pride organisation suspended 2026 events, and a venue withdrew from a Pride event under school-board pressure.",
     "local_evidence": "\"a city council rescinded its LGBTQ non-discrimination ordinance (Dec 2025), a local Pride organisation suspended its 2026 events, and a venue pulled out of a Pride event\"",
     "direction": "riskier", "magnitude": 0.01,
     "visitor_applicability": "Weak social-climate signal; LGB-facing rather than trans-specific, and it does not create an enforcement exposure for a visitor, but it indicates shrinking visible community space and local recourse pointed at travellers who seek it.",
     "already_in_national_bundle": false, "counted_in_delta": true},
    {"fact": "The state's bathroom law reaches prisons only as to restroom use and does not govern cell assignment or housing placement of trans prisoners.",
     "local_evidence": "\"the companion gender-placements statute reaches prisons only as to restroom use; it does not govern cell assignment or the housing placement of trans prisoners\"",
     "direction": "safer", "magnitude": 0.01,
     "visitor_applicability": "Only relevant to a detained traveller; it is the absence of an additional hostile rule, not a documented protection, so it cannot be credited as a working safeguard.",
     "already_in_national_bundle": true, "counted_in_delta": false},
    {"fact": "State prison policy excluded gender-confirmation surgery and a court affirmed no deliberate indifference, treating refusal as a permissible medical choice (2019 ruling).",
     "local_evidence": "\"denied gender-confirmation surgery because the agency's official treatment policy excluded the procedure\"; \"the courts affirmed no deliberate indifference\"",
     "direction": "riskier", "magnitude": 0.01,
     "visitor_applicability": "Custody care denial affecting a detained traveller; dated (2019) and of a kind already priced in the national custody record (national conversion-therapy-style policies, denial of care), so it is not scored separately.",
     "already_in_national_bundle": true, "counted_in_delta": false},
    {"fact": "No statewide gender-identity anti-discrimination law; state hate-crime statute covers only sexual orientation and prosecutions are rare.",
     "local_evidence": "\"The state hate-crime statute enhances penalties for crimes motivated by sexual orientation but does not cover gender identity\"; \"no statewide law barring discrimination on the basis of gender identity\"",
     "direction": "riskier", "magnitude": 0.01,
     "visitor_applicability": "Absence of resident-facing anti-discrimination/hate-crime machinery: per the rating rules a missing domestic statute is a resident gap and climate cue, not a documented visitor exposure.",
     "already_in_national_bundle": false, "counted_in_delta": false},
    {"fact": "The state is placed in the top 'Do Not Travel' tier for adult trans travellers in the July 2026 law-by-law legal-risk assessment, alongside three other states.",
     "local_evidence": "\"A national legal risk assessment dated July 2026 places the state in the top 'Do Not Travel' tier for adult trans travellers, alongside three other states\"",
     "direction": "riskier", "magnitude": 0.01,
     "visitor_applicability": "Advocacy grading, not a state practice; it summarises statutory conditions largely already captured above and in the national bundle rather than adding an independent traveller-facing exposure.",
     "already_in_national_bundle": true, "counted_in_delta": false},
    {"fact": "A dormant same-sex-only sodomy statute remains on the books (repeal failed in the upper chamber in 2025).",
     "local_evidence": "\"the state remains one of three states retaining a dormant same-sex-only sodomy statute termed deviate sexual intercourse; a 2025 lower-chamber repeal passed that chamber and failed in the upper chamber\"",
     "direction": "riskier", "magnitude": 0.0,
     "visitor_applicability": "LGB statute, not trans law; no documented use as a lever against gender-nonconforming people, so it is at most a tangential signal.",
     "already_in_national_bundle": false, "counted_in_delta": false}
  ],
  "inherited_national_exposure": [
    "National 20 January 2025 executive order redefining sex as binary at conception, barring government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with gender identity, and banning self-selected markers on passports and visas",
    "Foreign ministry halting X-marker processing (Feb 2025); Supreme Court letting passport sex-marker restrictions take effect (Nov 2025); documented confiscation/blocking of trans passports and travellers stranded abroad",
    "Visa flagging and permanent-ban 'fraud' treatment of applicants listing a gender other than assigned sex (Feb 2025), plus allied-government travel advisories for trans citizens (Mar/Apr 2025)",
    "National bathroom-ban landscape (9 states plus more; one state criminalising trans bathroom use; the April 2025 capitol restroom arrest) - the general hostile-facilities baseline",
    "National custody harm: corrections-bureau conversion-therapy-style policies from 2026, denial of care, non-reporting of trans prisoner numbers, and immigration-custody forced labour, beatings, solitary confinement and sexual abuse",
    "National hate-crimes statute covering gender identity, the 2020 employment ruling, and the patchy state-level bias-crime landscape (23 states covering gender identity; 34 not)",
    "National December 2025 bounty instruction on trans activists and the May 2026 counterterrorism framing of 'radically pro-transgender' ideology",
    "National measurement environment: no trans-specific killing or violence rate at country level, contested/unresolved litigation, and proposed (not final) health rules"
  ],
  "uncertainty": "No state general homicide rate or total population denominator is supplied, so the 7.6 per 100k trans-women figure can be calibrated only against the region's ordinary baseline, not the state's own; it is weighted as elevated-background rather than campaign violence. The dossier documents facility ID checks only on 6 December 2025 and no later episode, so the current frequency of restroom ID-checking is unresolved; troopers admitting trans women with female ID markers suggests a visitor with a matching passport marker may pass, so severity is carried rather than demonstrated. Whether existing state IDs with changed markers survive the September 2025 definition act is unsourced. It is ambiguous whether this state is the newly flagged fourth 'Do Not Travel' state in the national bundle or another of the four, so that tier is treated as inherited. No local trans-specific border, hotel, or emergency-care denial incident against a visitor appears, so the delta rests on statutory universal exposure, the dated in-state violence record, and civil-society rollback; on a thin local record the delta is deliberately modest, and a zero would have been diagnostic of missing evidence rather than of equality.",
  "notes": "Signed delta only: 0.330 + (-0.09). The only new state-imposed, traveller-facing element is the women's-privacy statute's document-matched restroom rule with fines and documented trooper ID checks - a universal-exposure measure, so it is the heaviest local input, capped because most bathroom-restriction landscape is already inside the national level and the documented enforcement admitted female-marked ID holders. The substantive local additions beyond the inherited national regime are the dated in-state homicide record and the visible rollback of local LGBTQ infrastructure; the resident-facing definition act, custody care denial, missing hate-crime/anti-discrimination coverage and dormant sodomy statute are climate signals and are not counted. Equality with the national level is not asserted - the local hostile layer is real, but it overlaps heavily with national exposure already priced at 0.330."}
